name: A Pilot's Revenge
summary: Searchers find Hildelve frozen in the wilds of Dun Morogh. His journal records the struggle that ended his life and his final wish for vengeance.

sections.title: A Final Entry
sections.body: Pilot Hildelve lies dead among Dun Morogh's snowy crags, with his journal beside him. In its final entry, he describes a savage fight with a huge Ice Claw bear he named Mangeclaw. Hildelve drove the beast off at first, but his wounds were severe. Mangeclaw returned and killed the weakened pilot.

sections.title: A Pilot's Dying Wish
sections.body: Hildelve's journal carries one last plea: avenge his death at the hands of the beast. Bringing the journal and a claw torn from Mangeclaw to Pilot Hammerfoot gives the Ironforge Siege Brigade grim closure and honors its lost comrade.

faq.answer: Pilot Hildelve was a dwarven siege engine pilot in the Ironforge Siege Brigade. When his engine broke down, he set out on foot into the mountains of Dun Morogh. His friend Pilot Hammerfoot sent searchers, who found Hildelve's remains in the snow.
Mangeclaw is an exceptionally large and ferocious Ice Claw bear roaming Dun Morogh's slopes. It ambushed Pilot Hildelve, wounded him mortally, then returned and killed him.

Pilot Hammerfoot is a seasoned siege engine pilot stationed in Dun Morogh and a member of the Ironforge Siege Brigade. Concerned for his missing friend Hildelve, he sends you into the wilds to learn what happened.

faq.q: Why does Hildelve's death matter to Ironforge?
faq.answer: The Ironforge Siege Brigade relies on trained pilots and machinery to scout and defend the mountainous territory around the capital. Hildelve's death is a harsh blow to its ranks.

faq.q: Where does this quest chain begin?
aliases: how to start a pilot's revenge
faq.answer: Pilot Hammerfoot begins the journey by asking you to find his missing friend in “The Lost Pilot.” Finding Hildelve's corpse starts “A Pilot's Revenge.”

faq.q: What proof do you need to bring to Hammerfoot?
faq.answer: Bring Hildelve's Journal from the pilot's corpse and a Mangy Claw taken from Mangeclaw's carcass to prove the beast was slain.

angles.text: As a dwarf, avenging a fallen Ironforge Siege Brigade comrade honors Hildelve's memory and punishes his killer.
As an Alliance member, you know the Ironforge pilots are a vital part of dwarven and Alliance defenses. Recovering lost pilots is an essential duty.
As a hunter, tracking an unusually vicious alpha beast like Mangeclaw through Dun Morogh's freezing winds tests your mountain survival skills.
